job.title: Shift Engineer
job.description:
Shift Maintenance Engineer - Client Direct - Commercial Office – Canary Wharf, East London - £57,562


CBW is proud to partner with a direct client based in the heart of Canary Wharf. We’re searching for a talented Day Shift Maintenance Engineer to join a high-performing team within a landmark commercial office space. This is your chance to work in a fast-paced, high-spec environment — no two days will be the same.

  • Mechanical Equipment: Pumps, motors, seals, bearings, basic HVAC
  • HVAC & Plant: AHUs, FCUs, emergency lighting, air conditioning units

What’s in It for You?
  • £57, 562 Salary (including shift allowance)
  • 25 Days Holiday (on a shift basis)
  • 12.5% employer pension contribution 
  • Private Healthcare & Dental
  • Cycle to Work Scheme
  • Subsidised Gym Membership
  • Training & Development: Internal and external courses
  • Career Progression Opportunities
  • Overtime Available
  • Life Assurance
 
What We’re Looking For:
  • Electrically qualified (City & Guilds Level 3 or equivalent)
  • 18th Edition
  • Strong knowledge of commercial building services
  • Experience in similar critical/commercial environments (e.g., banks, data centres, corporate HQs)
  • Ability to work at heights outdoors (full training & PPE provided)
Ready to Apply? Send your CV to Fin Havering at CBW Staffing Solutions today to find out more and take the next step in your engineering career!

job.title: Maintenance Electrician
job.description:
Site based Maintenance Electrician (Weekends & Evenings) - Sheffield - National Facilities Management Organisation: Hospitality & Public Sector

CBW Staffing Solutions are seeking a skilled Maintenance Electrician to join our client on a permanent basis, who are a leading provider in facilities management solutions, delivering top-tier services across public sector and hospitality industries.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electrical maintenance within commercial settings, as they will be responsible for diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining electrical systems and equipment to ensure optimal functionality and safety.

This is a site based opportunity, located in Sheffield City Centre, South Yorkshire - free parking is available on site.

Please note: This role is predominantly evening and weekend based, in line with the site’s events schedule. The successful candidate must be comfortable working regular evening and weekend shifts and be flexible to meet the operational requirements of the site. Any additional hours worked will be compensated through TOIL (Time Off in Lieu).

Package
  • Competitive salary up to £40,000 per annum (depending on experience)
  • Predominantly evening and weekend working, scheduled around the site's events calendar (37 hours per week)
  • Participation in an ‘out of hours’ on call rota (to be confirmed)
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Generous workplace pension scheme
  • Training, development & progression opportunities

Responsibilities
  • Conduct routine inspections of electrical systems to identify and resolve issues promptly
  • Perform preventive maintenance tasks to minimise downtime and ensure the longevity of electrical equipment
  • Troubleshoot electrical faults and implement effective solutions to restore functionality
  • Install, repair, and maintain electrical components, such as wiring, circuit breakers, and lighting fixtures
  • Collaborate with other maintenance personnel and contractors to coordinate repairs and upgrades
  • Adhere to safety protocols and regulations to create a secure working environment

Qualifications
  • Qualified to at least City & Guilds Level 3 in Electrical Installation or equivalent
  • Proven experience as a Maintenance Electrician or similar role within the facilities management industry
  • Strong knowledge of electrical systems, wiring, and circuitry
  • Proficiency in diagnosing and repairing electrical faults
  • Familiarity with electrical codes and regulations
  • Ability to read technical diagrams and blueprints
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Effective communication and teamwork abilities

If you are a dedicated Maintenance Electrician looking for a rewarding career opportunity, please apply with your full CV or contact Amy O’Shea at CBW Staffing Solutions.

The role will involve overseeing electrical engineering resources, including HV and LV systems, while ensuring critical infrastructure remains safe, compliant and operational. You will take responsibility for planned, reactive and lifecycle maintenance, working closely with operational teams, clients, contractors and other stakeholders.

This is a key leadership position requiring a strong combination of technical knowledge, people management, commercial awareness and operational experience.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead, manage and support electrical engineering teams to ensure services are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required standards.
  • Maintain the reliability and integrity of critical electrical systems while minimising equipment and asset downtime.
  • Oversee planned preventative and reactive maintenance activities, ensuring work is completed within agreed timescales and properly documented.
  • Manage CAFM systems, including work allocation, asset information, maintenance schedules and reporting.
  • Ensure Safe Systems of Work and Permit to Work procedures are consistently applied.
  • Provide leadership for Authorised Persons (APs) and Competent Persons (CPs), ensuring technical appointments and responsibilities are appropriately managed.
  • Coordinate additional works, lifecycle replacement programmes and the procurement of equipment and materials.
  • Monitor external contractors and supply chain partners, ensuring performance, compliance, quality and safety requirements are maintained.
  • Promote a positive Health, Safety and Environmental culture through regular inspections, reporting and proactive risk management.
  • Ensure statutory, technical and contractual documentation remains accurate and up to date.

job.title: Electrician (Renewable)
job.description:

Due to continued growth in the renewable energy sector, we are recruiting experienced professionals to support the delivery of residential and commercial Solar PV and Battery Storage installations across Scotland and the wider UK.

Successful candidates will join dedicated installation teams, working together to deliver high-quality renewable energy systems safely, efficiently, and to industry standards.

Each installation team typically consists of:

  • Renewable Energy Electricians (2 positions per team) – Responsible for the installation, testing, commissioning, and certification of Solar PV and Battery Storage systems, including AC/DC wiring, inverters, and associated electrical equipment in accordance with current industry regulations.

  • Install, commission and test Solar PV, Battery Storage, EV Charging and Air Source Heat Pump (ASHP) electrical systems.
  • Complete AC/DC wiring, inverters, consumer unit upgrades and associated electrical works.
  • Carry out inspection, testing, fault finding and certification in accordance with BS 7671 and relevant industry standards.
  • Accurately complete digital job records, certification and quality assurance documentation, including photographic evidence where required.
  • Liaise professionally with customers, site teams and project managers to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Maintain high standards of health, safety and workmanship, supporting labourers and apprentices where required.

Essential:

  • NVQ Level 3 in Electrical Installation (or equivalent)
  • 18th Edition Wiring Regulations
  • Inspection & Testing qualification (2391 or equivalent)
  • ECS/JIB Gold Card
  • Full UK Driving Licence
  • Minimum three years' electrical installation experience
  • Strong knowledge of BS 7671 and safe isolation procedures
  • Comfortable using tablets or digital job management systems
Desirable:

  • Experience installing Solar PV and Battery Storage - (training/certification on EV charging will be provided).
  • Experience working on social housing or large-scale renewable energy programmes.
  • Knowledge of G98/G99 grid connection requirements.
  • Manufacturer training on leading renewable energy products is advantageous but not essential.
Salary & Benefits:

  • Salary up to £50,000 OT £70,000
  • Company vehicle and fuel card.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Uniform, PPE and specialist tools provided.
  • Accommodation and meal allowances when working away where required.
  • Consistent workload across Solar PV, Battery Storage, EV Charging and Heat Pump projects.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.

The role involves overseeing the delivery of electrical building services across a busy, occupied environment, ensuring all planned and reactive maintenance activities are completed safely, efficiently, and to the highest standards. Hours of Work

Monday to Friday, 08:00am – 17:00pm

Key Duties & Responsibilities
  • Supervise and coordinate a team of electrical maintenance engineers and specialist subcontractors
  • Ensure all planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive works are completed in accordance with contractual requirements
  • Review and approve Risk Assessments and Method Statements (RAMS)
  • Issue and manage Permits to Work in line with site safety procedures
  • Monitor maintenance activities through CAFM systems, ensuring records are accurate and up to date
  • Ensure full compliance with Health & Safety legislation, statutory regulations, and company procedures
  • Produce technical reports, monitor KPIs and SLAs, and support contract performance reviews
  • Liaise with site stakeholders and operational teams to maintain exceptional service delivery
  • Identify electrical plant and equipment defects, coordinating remedial and improvement works

  • Ensure electrical compliance, testing and maintenance activities are completed and accurately documented

  • Electrically qualified (City & Guilds Level 3, NVQ Level 3, or equivalent)
  • 18th Edition Wiring Regulations
  • Previous experience in a Supervisory or Lead Engineer position within FM or Building Services
  • Strong understanding of RAMS, Permit to Work systems, and compliance processes
  • Experience using CAFM systems and producing maintenance reports
  • Good knowledge of commercial electrical building services and associated plant
  • Experience working within critical or highly regulated environments would be advantageous
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workloads effectively

If you're looking to move into automation engineering with full support and training, apply today or contact Amy at CBW Staffing Solutions for more information.

job.title: Electrical Technical Manager
job.description:
Technical Services Manager - Fife  Hours: 37.5 hours per week Working Hours: Flexible between 7:00am and 5:00pm

CBW are seeking an experienced Technical Services Manager – Electrical to provide effective leadership and technical management across a complex healthcare facilities environment.

You will be responsible for the successful delivery of electrical and hard services, ensuring contractual obligations, service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) are consistently achieved.

The role will involve overseeing electrical engineering resources, including HV and LV systems, while ensuring critical infrastructure remains safe, compliant and operational. You will take responsibility for planned, reactive and lifecycle maintenance, working closely with operational teams, clients, contractors and other stakeholders.

This is a key leadership position requiring a strong combination of technical knowledge, people management, commercial awareness and operational experience.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead, manage and support electrical engineering teams to ensure services are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required standards.
  • Maintain the reliability and integrity of critical electrical systems while minimising equipment and asset downtime.
  • Oversee planned preventative and reactive maintenance activities, ensuring work is completed within agreed timescales and properly documented.
  • Manage CAFM systems, including work allocation, asset information, maintenance schedules and reporting.
  • Ensure Safe Systems of Work and Permit to Work procedures are consistently applied.
  • Provide leadership for Authorised Persons (APs) and Competent Persons (CPs), ensuring technical appointments and responsibilities are appropriately managed.
  • Coordinate additional works, lifecycle replacement programmes and the procurement of equipment and materials.
  • Monitor external contractors and supply chain partners, ensuring performance, compliance, quality and safety requirements are maintained.
  • Promote a positive Health, Safety and Environmental culture through regular inspections, reporting and proactive risk management.
  • Ensure statutory, technical and contractual documentation remains accurate and up to date.
  • Lead and support internal and external audits, ensuring any identified actions are addressed promptly.
  • Maintain effective communication with clients and key stakeholders, attending meetings and providing accurate performance updates and reports.
  • Maintain training records, competency information and technical appointment registers.
  • Manage team performance, including appraisals, development plans and ongoing training requirements.
  • Work closely with the central Service Desk to support workforce planning and maintain operational continuity.
  • Ensure operational procedures, LOPs and technical documentation remain compliant with legislation and industry best practice.
  • Participate in an out-of-hours/on-call management rota as required.
  • Prepare regular contract performance, energy management and operational reports.
  • Monitor budgets, expenditure and financial forecasts to ensure effective commercial management.
  • Support and promote organisational values relating to ethics, equality, diversity and inclusion.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duties required by the Line Manager.
Benefits and Package The successful candidate will receive a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package, including:

  • 25 days annual leave plus public holidays.
  • Life assurance equivalent to twice your annual salary.
  • Employee discounts with a wide range of major retailers and brands.
  • Gym membership discounts.
  • Cycle to Work scheme.
  • Holiday purchase scheme.
  •  
Essential Requirements
  • HNC/HND in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent discipline.
  • Recognised electrical qualifications and/or fully qualified electrician status.
  • At least five years' post-qualification experience within a comparable technical or contract management position.
  • Demonstrable experience managing electrical and hard services within a contractual environment.
  • Strong leadership and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Good commercial and financial management experience.
  • Full UK driving licence.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Disclosure Scotland/PVG clearance.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and CAFM systems.
Desirable Experience
  • Previous experience working within healthcare facilities management.
  • Knowledge of relevant healthcare technical standards, including SHTM 06-01, SHTM 06-02 and SHTM 06-03.
  • LV and HV Authorised/Approved Person experience or certification.
  • Knowledge of Confined Spaces, Fire Safety and Lift management.
  • Experience managing projects and delivering works within a live operational environment.

job.title: Shift Leader
job.description:
Shift Leader - City of London - FM Service Provider - £66,800 per annum

A leading facilities management service provider is seeking an experienced Shift Leader to oversee a site-based engineering team within a large, modern commercial office building in the City of London.

Working in a high-specification, business-critical environment, you will be responsible for supporting and leading the engineering team to ensure the safe and effective operation of all building services. The role will remain predominantly hands-on, carrying out planned and reactive maintenance across electrical and mechanical systems, while also overseeing day-to-day coordination, reporting and communication with clients, contractors and management. The successful candidate must be HVAP qualified, with strong electrical technical knowledge and proven experience within commercial building services. You will be confident leading engineers, maintaining safe systems of work and ensuring high standards of service delivery. Strong communication skills and a proactive, team-focused approach are essential.

Hours of work:

7 -7, Continental, Day & Nights

Key Duties & Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of technical services across the site, managing shift engineers and specialist contractors
  • Supervise and support the on-site engineering team, ensuring an efficient and customer-focused service
  • Act as HV Authorised Person (HVAP), ensuring the safe operation and compliance of high-voltage systems
  • Manage PPM and reactive maintenance, ensuring works are completed correctly and within agreed timescales
  • Ensure all statutory, technical and health & safety compliance requirements are maintained
  • Operate and enforce Safe Systems of Work, including Permit to Work (PTW), RAMS and isolation procedures
  • Maintain accurate maintenance, compliance and operational records
  • Lead the investigation and reporting of operational incidents and technical issues
  • Ensure engineers and contractors are suitably trained, equipped and working safely
  • Conduct and contribute to monthly technical, compliance and health & safety reviews
  • Build strong working relationships with the client, contractors, building occupants and wider management team
  • Provide technical guidance and leadership to the engineering team during day-to-day operations and critical incidents
Requirements
  • Fully electrically or mechanically qualified – City & Guilds / HNC / HND or equivalent
  • HVAP qualification – essential
  • Strong electrical or mechanical technical background
  • Previous experience in a Shift Leader, Lead Engineer or similar supervisory role
  • Proven experience within commercial building maintenance / building services
  • Strong leadership and team management skills
  • Good knowledge of health & safety, statutory compliance and Safe Systems of Work
  • Experience with Permit to Work (PTW), RAMS and HV systems
  • Strong client-facing and communication skills
  • Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office
Please send your CV to katie at CBW Staffing Solutions for more information.

job.title: Permit Manager
job.description:
Permit Manager - FM Service Provider - Holborn, Central London - up to 65K 

 One of our key clients are currently looking to recruit a permit manager for a brand new contract based in the Holborn area of Central London.  

The ideal candidate will be either electrically or mechanically qualified and will be responsible for ensuring all planned works are scheduled in accordance with the maintenance planner.  

They will also be responsible for all contractor visitors and making sure they are inducted and authority to work are submitted and approved in advance of site attendance.   

The role will be working 8.00 to 17.00 Monday to Friday and the main duties are below

Key duties & responsibilities
  • Prepares Compliance audit data by compiling and analysing internal and external information
  • Ensures all required compliance documentation is saved / uploaded as required, including service reports from engineers and vendors
  • To operate a Permit to Work System in accordance with Quality, Health & Safety procedures and client requirements
  • Carry out regular mini audits on compliance documentation to ensure all service reports are received in good time and report on overdue / imminently due PPMs / Reactive
  • Monitors planned and due dates to ensure statutory compliance levels are maintained at all times, with any breaches identified to the Contract Manager
  • Review engineer training records & ensure Training Matrix is always up to date
  • Maintain Permit to Work statistics
  • Review safe systems of works to ensure compliance with legal/customer requirements
  • Review risk assessments to ensure compliance
  • Ensure site inductions are completed and current.
  • Archiving of all AtW’s and PtW’s and keeping them readily available for audit.
  • Ensure that Planned Preventative Maintenance and reactive works are carried out in line with task schedules and industry best practice to ensure the site is fully compliant.
  • Ensure that accurate and comprehensive records are kept pertaining to Health & Safety, Building Compliance and Quality Assurance.
  • Ensure that plant faults and defects are swiftly remedies to maintain the plant in serviceable order at all times.
  • Ensure the Computer Based Maintenance system is kept up to date and that PPM and reactive tickets are closed out with accurate data captured.
  • Undertake other tasks as defined and requested by local management.
  • Ensure an awareness and compliance to the contractual KPI’s/SLA’s.
  Requirements
  • Recognised qualification to BTEC, ONC or HNC level for Electrical/Mechanical engineering or equivalent discipline
  • Ideally hold an QSHE/Health and Safety Certification (IOSH etc)
  • A strong and committed team player capable of prioritising and solving problems often under pressure, utilising innovative solutions.
  • Must be well organised with good task management skills, who can communicate effectively (written & verbal) and be able to operate independently.
  • Knowledge and awareness of the facilities management industry
  • Ideally a NEBOSH Certification
  • Hold/Working towards professional body (IET, CIBSE etc)

job.title: Facilities Helpdesk Administrator
job.description:
Facilities & Maintenance Administrator – £35,000- Wickford Essex- Full Time Office Based

My client, a well-established facilities and maintenance provider, is looking for an experienced Facilities & Maintenance Administrator to join their busy Help Desk team based in Wickford, Essex.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced professional with a background in facilities management, maintenance coordination or Help Desk operations to join a successful and supportive organisation, with opportunities for development and career progression.

Reporting to the Help Desk Manager, you will play a key role in coordinating maintenance works from initial instruction through to completion. You will be responsible for scheduling works, liaising with clients, contractors and suppliers, monitoring outstanding jobs and ensuring all systems and records are accurate and up to date.

  • Monday to Friday, 8:30am – 5:00pm
  • Full-time
  • Office-based
  • Wickford, Essex
  • Overtime available and must be willing to work occasional Out of Hours- Paid as overtime
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage incoming maintenance requests via telephone, email and client portals.
  • Scheduling Engineers and closing down completed jobs
  • PPMS and Raising Purchase Orders 
  • Log and update work requests accurately within the CAFM system.
  • Allocate reactive and planned maintenance jobs to the appropriate trades, contractors and suppliers.
  • Coordinate appointments and arrange site access with clients, contractors and suppliers.
  • Monitor jobs from initial instruction through to completion, ensuring works are progressed within agreed timescales.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed job notes throughout the lifecycle of each work order.
  • Liaise with suppliers and contractors to obtain quotations, provide updates and chase outstanding works.
  • Raise purchase orders and arrange required permits, RAMS and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure quotations, job updates, reports and relevant documentation are uploaded accurately to the CAFM system and client portals.
  • Coordinate Handyman and Electrical PPM works, ensuring schedules and client requirements are met.

job.title: Renewable Electrician
job.description:
lectrician - Central Belt - Salary 40-45K plus excellent bonus structure (OT £400 per week) 

Due to continued growth in the renewable energy sector, we are recruiting experienced professionals to support the delivery of residential and commercial Solar PV and Battery Storage installations across Scotland and the wider UK.

Successful candidates will join dedicated installation teams, working together to deliver high-quality renewable energy systems safely, efficiently, and to industry standards.

Each installation team typically consists of:

  • Renewable Energy Electricians (2 positions per team) – Responsible for the installation, testing, commissioning, and certification of Solar PV and Battery Storage systems, including AC/DC wiring, inverters, and associated electrical equipment in accordance with current industry regulations.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Install, commission and test Solar PV, Battery Storage, EV Charging and Air Source Heat Pump (ASHP) electrical systems.
  • Complete AC/DC wiring, inverters, consumer unit upgrades and associated electrical works.
  • Carry out inspection, testing, fault finding and certification in accordance with BS 7671 and relevant industry standards.
  • Accurately complete digital job records, certification and quality assurance documentation, including photographic evidence where required.
  • Liaise professionally with customers, site teams and project managers to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Maintain high standards of health, safety and workmanship, supporting labourers and apprentices where required.
Person Specification:

Essential:

  • NVQ Level 3 in Electrical Installation (or equivalent)
  • 18th Edition Wiring Regulations
  • Inspection & Testing qualification (2391 or equivalent)
  • ECS/JIB Gold Card
  • Full UK Driving Licence
  • Minimum three years' electrical installation experience
  • Strong knowledge of BS 7671 and safe isolation procedures
  • Comfortable using tablets or digital job management systems
Desirable:

  • Experience installing Solar PV, Battery Storage and EV Charging systems.
  • Experience working on social housing or large-scale renewable energy programmes.
  • Knowledge of G98/G99 grid connection requirements.
  • Manufacturer training on leading renewable energy products is advantageous but not essential.
Salary & Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with excellent bonus structure - circa £400 per week 
  • Company vehicle and fuel card.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Uniform, PPE and specialist tools provided.
  • Accommodation and meal allowances when working away where required.
  • Consistent workload across Solar PV, Battery Storage, EV Charging and Heat Pump projects.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.

job.title: Facilities Helpdesk Manager

A leading facilities and maintenance provider is looking to appoint an experienced Facilities Helpdesk Manager to oversee and lead a busy, customer-focused Helpdesk operation based in Basildon.
This is a key leadership position for an experienced Facilities, Maintenance or FM Helpdesk professional who is looking to take responsibility for operational performance, customer relationships, team development and continuous improvement. You will be responsible for ensuring the Helpdesk operates efficiently and delivers a consistently high level of service, while meeting contractual KPIs and SLAs and maintaining strong relationships with customers, contractors and internal stakeholders.

This is a fully office-based position in Basildon, working Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm.

The successful candidate will have previous experience managing a Facilities, Maintenance or FM Helpdesk, ideally within a facilities and maintenance provider, facilities management, property services or a similar environment. You'll be an experienced people manager with the confidence to lead a busy operation, manage customer escalations and make decisions in a fast-paced environment.

Experience & Skills
  • Previous experience managing a Facilities, Maintenance or FM Helpdesk.
  • Strong people leadership and team management experience.
  • Experience working to contractual KPIs and SLAs.
  • Good understanding of reactive and planned maintenance.
  • Experience managing contractors and third-party suppliers.
  • Strong customer service and relationship management skills.
  • Confident handling customer complaints and escalations.
  • Excellent organisational and prioritisation skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making ability.
  • Commercial awareness and an understanding of operational performance.
  • A proactive approach to continuous improvement.
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills.
Key Responsibilities
  • Take ownership of the customer experience across the Helpdesk operation.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and stakeholders.
  • Act as a senior point of contact for customer queries, concerns and escalations.
  • Lead the resolution of customer complaints, ensuring issues are dealt with promptly and professionally.
  • Ensure customers receive clear and regular communication throughout the lifecycle of maintenance works.
  • Identify recurring service issues and introduce preventative measures to improve customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Lead the day-to-day operation of the Facilities Helpdesk, ensuring a professional, efficient and responsive service.
  • Oversee reactive and planned maintenance requests from initial instruction through to completion.
  • Manage workloads, priorities and resources to ensure service levels are consistently maintained.
  • Ensure Priority 1 and Priority 2 works are managed effectively, with appropriate communication and escalation.
  • Monitor workflow, outstanding and aged jobs, taking action to minimise delays.
  • Monitor contractor performance and ensure works are delivered within agreed timescales and to the required standards.
  • Ensure quotations are progressed efficiently and followed up to minimise customer delays.
  • Identify operational risks and implement effective solutions.
Skills Required
  • Lead, coach and develop the Helpdesk team to achieve high levels of performance.
  • Create a positive, accountable and customer-focused working environment.
  • Set clear expectations and ensure team members understand their responsibilities and targets.
  • Conduct regular one-to-one meetings, appraisals and performance reviews.
  • Identify training and development needs and support ongoing employee development.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding and training of new team members.
  • Manage attendance, wellbeing and performance in partnership with HR.
  • Take ownership of Helpdesk KPIs, SLAs and operational performance.
  • Monitor performance data and identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Produce regular reports and provide recommendations to senior management.
  • Monitor quotation turnaround times and identify opportunities to improve efficiency.
  • Review and improve Helpdesk processes, systems and procedures.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, service quality and customer satisfaction.
  • Support wider operational and strategic improvement programmes.
  • Make effective day-to-day operational decisions to maintain service delivery.
  • Balance customer requirements, team resources and operational priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and commercial performance.
  • Ensure operational activity is delivered in line with contractual obligations and company procedures.
  • Escalate significant operational, customer or commercial risks where appropriate.
  • Contribute to the continued growth and success of the wider business.
